title: Occasional members
statementMd:
List members who borrowed fewer than 6 books in total (zero counts). Show name and loan count.

Expected columns: `name`, `loans`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.name, COUNT(l.id) AS loans FROM members m LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name HAVING COUNT(l.id) < 6;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
